items.title: Karnataka High Court quashes case against snake rescuer accused of capturing King Cobra
items.summary: The Karnataka High Court recently quashed a criminal case against a snake rescuer accused of capturing and photographing a King Cobra. Justice Anant Ramanath Hegde on November 2 quashed the proceedings initiated against snake rescuer Dr. P Gowri Shankar. The Court held that the allegations did not establish that the petitioner had kept the snake in captivity, killed or injured it or uploaded its photographs on social media. “It is not the allegation that the petitioner has kept the king cobra in captivity, killed or injured [it], or uploaded the photograph,” the Court observed. Justice Anant Ramanath Hegde The case against Shankar was that he had captured a King Cobra and had taken its photograph while in captivity and also allowed others to take its photographs. The complaint against the petitioner was filed based on the social media publication where the petitioner was found in a video uploaded by a third person. The petitioner sought to quash trial court proceedings after he was booked for various offences under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
